title: single column
name: Single column
rule: Present fields in a single column (short related fields such as city/state/zip may share a row).
pass_when: Independent fields stack in one column; only short related fields share a row.
fail_when: Unrelated fields sit in multiple columns that force a zigzag fill path.
overview: Stack independent fields in one column; only short related fields share a row.
apply_when: Laying out multi-field forms on web or similar viewports.
not_when: Short related clusters like city/state/zip that intentionally share a row.
agent_hint: Use one column for independent fields; row-share only short related ones.
description: Present fields in a single column; short related fields such as city/state/zip may share a row. Pass when independent fields stack in one column and only short related fields share a row; fail when unrelated fields sit in multiple columns that force a zigzag fill path. Single-column reading beats zigzag scanning across the form for independent asks.
